name: Mammoth
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Fixed Perception 13 and Stealth 9. No listed special senses. No listed languages.
appearance: A massive woolly elephant with a high domed head, shaggy russet fur, an agile trunk and two sweeping ivory tusks.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, p. 363. The XP value comes from the CR table on p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR +6, DEX −1, CON +5, INT −4, WIS +0, CHA −2. The source lists modifiers and fixed Perception and Stealth values. It lists HP without a Hit Dice formula.
sections.Defenses: Resistant to cold damage and to the prone condition. Halve cold damage, rounding down. Roll with advantage on checks and saves to avoid becoming prone or to end the condition.
sections.Traits: Trampling Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hit it with Gore that turn. The creature must pass a DC 17 Strength save or fall prone. If it is prone, the mammoth can make one Stomp against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Gore attacks.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit with 10-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one prone creature. A hit deals 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Trunk Grab. Choose one Large or smaller creature within 10 ft. It makes a DC 17 Strength save. A failure leaves it grappled, escape DC 17, and restrained until the grapple ends. The mammoth cannot use Trunk Grab on another creature while this grapple remains.
sections.At the table: A charge Stomp has 5-ft. reach. Trunk Grab and the charge’s bonus-action Stomp compete for the mammoth’s bonus action.

name: Mammoth
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Passive Perception 10. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A massive woolly elephant with a high domed head, shaggy russet fur, an agile trunk and two sweeping ivory tusks.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, first printing (September 2014), printed p. 332. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16950-mammoth
sections.Traits: Trampling Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hit it with Gore that turn. The creature must pass a DC 18 Strength save or fall prone. If it is prone, the mammoth can make one Stomp against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit with 10-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one prone creature. A hit deals 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: Check the distance before using the bonus-action Stomp. Its 5-ft. reach is shorter than Gore’s 10-ft. reach.

name: Seahorse
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Fixed Perception 10 and Stealth 12. No listed special senses. No listed languages.
appearance: A small, upright fish with a horse-like head, tubular snout, ringed body and curled grasping tail.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, p. 368. The XP value comes from the CR table on p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR −5, DEX +0, CON −1, INT −5, WIS +0, CHA −4. The source lists modifiers and fixed Perception and Stealth values. It lists HP without a Hit Dice formula.
sections.Traits:
Underwater Camouflage. Use Stealth 17 while underwater.
Water Breathing. The seahorse breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions: Ram. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Spider
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Fixed Perception 10 and Stealth 14. Darkvision 30 ft. No listed languages.
appearance: A small orb-weaver with a rounded olive-brown abdomen, a compact head and eight slender legs.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, p. 371. The XP value comes from the CR table on p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR −4, DEX +0, CON −1, INT −5, WIS +0, CHA −4. The source lists modifiers and fixed Perception and Stealth values. It lists HP without a Hit Dice formula.
sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without a check.
Web Sense. While touching a web, pinpoint any other creature touching the same web.
Web Walker. Webs impose no movement restrictions on the spider.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one creature. A hit deals 2 (1d4) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 9 Constitution save and takes 2 (1d4) poison damage on a failure.
sections.Bonus actions: Web Shot, Recharge 4–6. Pick one creature the spider can see within 15 ft. It makes a DC 9 Dexterity save. On a failure its speed drops by 10 ft. A creature can remove the webbing as an action to end the effect.
sections.At the table: After using Web Shot, roll a d6 at the start of each of the spider’s turns. It regains the shot on 4–6 or after a short or long rest.

name: Tiger
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 13 and Stealth 16. Darkvision 60 ft. No listed languages.
appearance: A muscular striped cat with an ochre coat, ivory cheeks, rounded ears, thick forepaws and a long tail.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, p. 372. The XP value comes from the CR table on p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR +3, DEX +2, CON +2, INT −4, WIS +1, CHA −1. The source lists modifiers and fixed Perception and Stealth values. It lists HP without a Hit Dice formula.
sections.Traits:
Heightened Smell. Use Perception 18 for smell.
Pounce. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hit it with Claws that turn. The creature must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone. If the creature is prone, the tiger can make one Bite against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack. If both hit the same creature, it makes a DC 13 Constitution save at the start of its next turn. A failed save costs 5 (2d4) HP from bleeding.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one creature. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.
